item.slimic.friendly_slime.tooltip: A companion that follows you and grows through activity. Combine it with profession ingredients to specialize it.
item.slimic.friendly_slime.stored_toolti: Right-click to release this companion in Wait with its saved traits.
message.slimic.friendly_slime.captured: Your slime has been recovered into your inventory.
message.slimic.friendly_slime.inventory_: You need an empty main inventory slot to recover your slime.
item.slimic.friendly_slime.manage_toolti: Right-click with a Slime Tuner to manage; use a Slime Scanner to preview work areas.
item.slimic.mining_slime.tooltip: Select Mine to excavate its chunk with a pickaxe and shovel. Fluids require an empty bucket in its bag; wall repairs use cobblestone.
screen.slimic.name: Slime name
screen.slimic.upgrade_tooltip: Spend one stat point to upgrade this stat.
screen.slimic.specialize: Craft a Friendly Slime with other ingredients to specialize it. See the gameplay guide for recipes.
status.slimic.no_tool: Equip a pickaxe or shovel, or add a spare to the bag
status.slimic.full: Bag full; unload to resume mining
status.slimic.disabled: Block changes are not permitted; mining paused
jei.slimic.friendly_slime: Use on a block or water source to summon your companion, or feed a golden apple to a tiny wild Slime to tame one in Wait. Use a Slime Tuner to manage its name, stats, equipment, and orders. Shift-right-click to recover it with its saved traits. One slimeball restores up to four health; a water bucket removes dye.
jei.slimic.mining_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a pickaxe to equip that exact tool. Initially waits; select Mine to begin. Excavates downward in its release chunk, preserving and repairing a two-block-wide perimeter staircase. Replaces broken tools from its bag. Water and lava removal requires an empty bucket in its own bag without consuming or filling it. Seals side fluid inlets and large underground openings with its own cobblestone; missing material requests up to one stack from transport. Work Speed boosts block breaking only with an effective tool; an ineffective fallback keeps its ordinary breaking rate.
item.slimic.transport_slime.tooltip: Select Haul to collect requested cargo and deliver supplies from storage. Capacity is twice the common base.
status.slimic.transport.collecting: Collecting requested cargo from a companion
status.slimic.transport.no_chest: No available warehouse or Slime Chest
status.slimic.transport.unreachable: Cannot reach the target; looking for another route
jei.slimic.transport_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a regular chest. Initially waits; select Haul to begin. Capacity is twice the common base. Collects workers' requested cargo, preferring same-owner or mutually shared warehouses over Slime Chests, and tries other storage when full. Supplies replacement tools, empty buckets, up to one stack of wall cobblestone or healer slimeballs. Has no equipment slots.
jei.slimic.slime_chest: Craft eight wooden planks around a slimeball. This 27-slot container stores resources, replacement tools, and empty buckets for transport slimes. Regular chests are not used for automatic transport.
screen.slimic.tuner_help: No gameplay caps. Guardian/Royal Health ×4; Attention speed ×1.5. Job multipliers still apply. Amber values exceed recommendations.
status.slimic.needs_support: Add building blocks to the bag to repair the staircase
status.slimic.unreachable: The quarry route is blocked; retrying
jei.slimic.herald_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a firework rocket. Initially waits; select Watch to begin. Signals when a nearby same-owner or mutually shared worker stays blocked for the configured time, using the crafting rocket design. Signals need no additional rockets. Creative defaults use a white small-ball firework.
jei.slimic.slime_tuner: Craft one slimeball with one iron ingot. Use on your slime to manage its status, equipment, bag, name, and orders, or spend stat points. Use a Creative Slime Tuner to edit base stats directly.
screen.slimic.capacity_occupied: Empty the bag slots that would become unavailable before reducing Capacity.
item.slimic.slime_armor.tooltip: Equip in a Combat, Dragon, or Saddle Slime's armor slot. Retains the original chestplate's attributes and data.
jei.slimic.combat_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a sword. Initially waits; select Fight to attack enabled target types. Can equip a sword, shield, and Slime Armor. The default targets are hostile mobs except creepers. Never attacks primary or shared owners, their allied companions, or other allies. Target settings, stats, equipment, and bag survive recovery. Endermen retain native behavior; an Enderman targeting a living companion uses the Hostile filter until it disengages.
jei.slimic.cleaning_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with rotten flesh. Select Clean to collect dropped items around its fixed release position and return home. Detection Range is five times the common base. After three minutes without a pickup, selects another item or retries. Requests transport pickup when its bag is full.
jei.slimic.slime_armor: Craft any chestplate with one slimeball without a fixed shape. Preserves material, damage, enchantments, name, dye and attribute modifiers. Equip in a Combat, Dragon, or Saddle Slime's dedicated armor slot.
status.slimic.combat.no_sword: Equip a sword or add a spare to the bag
status.slimic.cleaning.full: Bag full; unload to resume cleaning
status.slimic.cleaning.unreachable: Pickup blocked; retrying or finding another item
screen.slimic.specialization_stat: Used by another slime type; upgrades remain saved.
screen.slimic.saddle_help:
Gear: saddle, elytra, slime armor
Slime Tuner: management
Right-click: mount
WASD/look: steer / Space: ascend
Ctrl: boost / Shift: dismount
jei.slimic.saddle_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a saddle. Right-click to ride and use the Slime Tuner to manage it. Equip elytra in the second slot for free flight and Slime Armor in the third slot for protection. Flight has diminishing Movement Speed gains and a speed limit. Flight and Ctrl boost spend stamina; exhaustion causes slow descent. Primary and shared owners can equip and ride. Gear, stats and current health survive recovery.
jei.slimic.farmer_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a hoe to equip that exact tool. Initially waits; Farm registers existing farmland within Detection Range, which is twice the common base. Plants bag seeds, harvests crops, and restores registered soil. Cannot trample farmland.
jei.slimic.lumberjack_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with an axe to equip that exact tool. Initially waits; select Chop to begin. Finds natural trees around its release position within Detection Range, which is twice the common base. Reserves one matching bag sapling per stump before felling and replants in place. The axe, its enchantments and log hardness determine cutting time.
screen.slimic.guardian_help:
Totem reserve: up to 64.
Retaliates with a beam against attackers of itself or its owner. Uses one totem to protect its owner from lethal damage within 16 blocks.
jei.slimic.creative_slime_tuner: Creative-only editor for base stats, current health, stamina, and unspent points. Values above recommendations remain usable with a mild warning. Guardian Angel and Royal Guard maximum health are four times their base Health. Finite numbers and whole slot/point counts are required; current resources fit the actual maximum. Empty occupied slots before reducing Capacity.
jei.slimic.guardian_angel_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime, nether star, and totem of undying to store that exact totem. Select Follow to fly beside its owner. Retaliates against attackers of itself or its owner and uses a totem to prevent lethal owner damage within 16 blocks. Retaliation and protection remain available during Wait. Maximum health is four times the common value.

status.slimic.lumberjack.moving: Moving to a tree or materials

status.slimic.lumberjack.disabled: Block changes are not permitted; logging paused
status.slimic.no_bucket: No empty bucket in the bag; waiting for transport supply
screen.slimic.soggy_info: Follow or roam to leave trails. Roam stays near its starting point within Detection Range. Each trail costs 1 stamina. Craft 4 Slime Slag into 1 slimeball.
jei.slimic.soggy_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a slimeball. Initially waits. Follow leaves trails behind its owner; Roam moves around the command location within Detection Range. Both use stamina to make trails. Each trail drops one Slime Slag and breaks faster with a shovel. Craft four slag into one slimeball.
status.slimic.no_cobblestone: No cobblestone in the bag; waiting for transport supply
jei.slimic.healing_slime: Craft a Friendly Slime with a golden carrot. Initially waits; Search treats same-owner or mutually shared companions near its release point. Each successful treatment consumes one bag slimeball and one stamina, heals up to 4 health, or revives a Broken Slime Block at 1 health. Transport can deliver slimeballs.
jei.slimic.warehouse_slime: Craft a Transport Slime with eight regular chests. Capacity is always four times a Transport Slime with the same stats. Initially waits; Store collects workers' requested cargo and supplies materials without depositing its own cargo in chests. Full storage pauses collection. Other carriers prefer same-owner or mutually shared warehouses over Slime Chests and try other storage when full.
status.slimic.healing.healing: Moving to or healing a companion
status.slimic.healing.reviving: Moving to or reviving a broken slime

book.slimic.guide.name: Slimic Companion Guide
book.slimic.guide.landing: Raise companions, assign work, and build a cooperative slime team. Start with a Friendly Slime and a Slime Tuner.
book.slimic.guide.subtitle: Growth & Teamwork
jei.slimic.fishing_slime: Friendly Slime + a fishing rod. The original rod keeps its enchantments, durability, name, and data. The slime starts waiting with this rod equipped. Choose Fish to find a nearby shore in its fixed area. Catches enter its bag. Five minutes of active work time without a catch makes it seek another spot. Lure shortens waiting; Luck of the Sea affects the native fishing loot table. Open water is required for treasure. Each catch costs one stamina and wears the rod normally. Unbreaking reduces wear; Mending uses catch experience to repair the rod. Work Speed shortens fishing waits. Full cargo and broken rods request carrier support.
jei.slimic.abundance_slime: Healing Slime + bone meal + a nether star. It retains the original companion, equipment, and bag, starts waiting, and carries a golden lyre. Choose Nurture. It retains healing and revival, prioritizing companions before applying native bonemeal effects to nearby growable crops, saplings, and other plants. Its fixed detection area is twice the common base, initially 16 blocks. A growth application uses two stamina and no bone meal item. Native random growth chances remain. Healing still needs slimeballs. Growth respects mobGriefing, bonemeal protection events, and loaded terrain. Carriers supply slimeballs and unload blocked bags.
jei.slimic.tunnel_slime: Mining Slime + one regular minecart. Its original tools, bag, health, and growth remain. It starts waiting and wears a minecart-shaped shell. Choose a horizontal direction and a lining block in management, then select Tunnel. It advances through a 3×3 passage, filling replaceable gaps and fluids around the floor, ceiling, and sides. It does not excavate an entire chunk. Click the template slot with a solid building block on your cursor. This only copies a one-block sample; the held stack is unchanged. An empty cursor clears it. Changing the template or direction pauses work. Cobblestone is the default template. Actual lining blocks come from its bag. Missing stock requests up to 64 blocks from carriers; missing stock at storage leaves it stopped. The template is never consumed. Pickaxe/shovel, tool tier, native enchantments, bucket-only fluid removal, cargo space, and shared quarry-stair protection still apply.
jei.slimic.dragon_slime: Combat Slime + a dragon head. It preserves the original sword, shield, armor, bag, filters, and growth, and starts waiting. Bat-shaped wings and dark horns identify it. Choose Fight and equip a sword. It flies toward enabled enemies, attacks with its sword, and periodically sends a ranged flame breath at a visible target in Detection Range. Work Speed shortens the breath interval. Breath costs four stamina, uses Attack damage, and can ignite its target. It follows the same ownership and target filters as melee. It does not set terrain on fire. Kill drops use the combat bag; full cargo does not stop fighting, and carriers may unload it.
jei.slimic.meow_slime: Friendly Slime + any raw cod, salmon, tropical fish, or pufferfish. Cooked fish does not work. It wears a cat head and starts Active + Wait. While active, nearby creepers use the same six-block avoidance goal used for cats. Activation and movement are independent: Active/Inactive does not change Wait/Roam, and changing movement does not change activation. It retains normal companion stats, naming, dyeing, healing, ownership, and recovery. It has no bag or equipment. Native avoidance is not a guarantee against a creeper that has already ignited.
screen.slimic.lining_help: Lining template: click with a block to copy its type; the held stack is unchanged. Empty click clears it. Changing it pauses work.

item.slimic.slime_teleporter.unbound: Link a fully rested Ender Slime to obtain a usable teleporter.
message.slimic.glow_unavailable: Fireflies need 10 stamina, open air, and a one-second interval.
message.slimic.ender_bind_unavailable: Linking needs full stamina, an empty inventory slot, and an available anchor slot.
message.slimic.teleporter_unavailable: The destination must be alive, pinned, accessible to you, fully rested, and have a safe landing.
screen.slimic.roster.tag_help: Select a companion to assign a tag. Gather uses the typed tag. Blank means untagged companions. Tags ignore letter case.
screen.slimic.roster.gather_help: Spend 25 stamina to gather living, released companions with this tag. They arrive waiting. Mounted and stored companions are excluded.
screen.slimic.roster.primary_only: The primary owner controls player relationships.
jei.slimic.glow_slime: Friendly Slime + glowstone dust. Starts waiting with its light on. Light has torch strength and costs no stamina. Right-click to spend 10 stamina on six-second fireflies. Light can be toggled independently in management.
item.slimic.glow_slime.tooltip: Provides torch-strength light without stamina cost. Right-click to spend 10 stamina on six-second fireflies; Light can be toggled separately.
jei.slimic.commander_slime: Friendly Slime + a book. Lists companions belonging to the Command Slime’s primary owner, including records, positions, health, orders, and tags. Shared owners may operate the roster and Gather; only the primary owner changes relationships. Gather spends 25 stamina; arrivals wait. Only one living released Command Slime is allowed per connected shared-owner group across all dimensions.
item.slimic.commander_slime.tooltip: Right-click for companion records, tags, sharing, and Gather. Gather spends 25 stamina and arrivals wait. One released Command Slime per connected shared-owner group.
jei.slimic.ender_slime: Friendly Slime + an ender pearl. With full stamina and an empty main-inventory slot, right-click with an empty hand to pin it and receive a bound Slime Teleporter. Linking spends all its stamina. Teleporting also requires and consumes full destination stamina. A pinned companion keeps its chunk ticking. Follow releases the anchor.
item.slimic.ender_slime.tooltip: With full stamina, an empty hand, and a free main-inventory slot, right-click to anchor it and obtain a bound Slime Teleporter. Linking and teleporting each spend full stamina; Follow releases the anchor.
jei.slimic.attention_slime: Friendly Slime + redstone dust. Starts waiting and has 50% higher effective Movement Speed than a companion with the same base stat. Roam keeps it moving playfully near its owner. Follow and Wait stop roaming. It has no bag or equipment. Can replace a Friendly Slime in basic specialization recipes; invested stats remain, while Attention roaming and its speed bonus end.
item.slimic.attention_slime.tooltip: Roams playfully with 50% higher Movement Speed at identical base stats. Can be used for basic specializations, retaining invested stats while losing Attention behavior and its speed bonus.
message.slimic.ender_anchor_limit: This owner's pinned Ender Slime limit has been reached.
message.slimic.commander_limit: This shared-owner group already has a Command Slime in the world.
message.slimic.commander_group_merge: Recover one Command Slime before joining these shared-owner groups.
item.slimic.herald_slime.tooltip: Select Watch to signal blocked workers with its saved firework design. Right-click to launch a manual signal.
item.slimic.combat_slime.tooltip: Equip a sword and select Fight to attack enabled target types. Supports a shield, Slime Armor, and a loot bag.
item.slimic.cleaning_slime.tooltip: Select Clean to collect nearby dropped items into its bag. Transport companions can unload it when full.
item.slimic.saddle_slime.tooltip: Ride with a saddle; equip elytra for flight. Boost (default: Ctrl) accelerates movement and spends extra stamina. Exhausted flight descends slowly.
item.slimic.farmer_slime.tooltip: Select Farm to harvest and replant registered crops. Needs a hoe and matching planting supplies.
item.slimic.lumberjack_slime.tooltip: Select Chop to harvest natural trees and replant them. Needs an axe and matching saplings.
item.slimic.guardian_angel_slime.tooltip: A flying protector that retaliates against nearby attackers. A reserve totem can rescue its owner from lethal damage within 16 blocks.
item.slimic.healing_slime.tooltip: Select Search to treat injured companions and revive Broken Slimes. Each treatment needs one slimeball from its bag.
item.slimic.warehouse_slime.tooltip: Select Store to collect cargo and supply workers. Retains collected cargo in its own bag, with four times a Transport Slime's Capacity at identical stats.
item.slimic.soggy_slime.tooltip: Leaves harvestable slime trails while moving in Follow or Roam. Wait stops trail placement.
item.slimic.fishing_slime.tooltip: Equip a fishing rod and select Fish to catch items from nearby water. Uses native fishing loot and rod enchantments.
item.slimic.abundance_slime.tooltip: Select Nurture to heal companions and encourage nearby plant growth. Healing uses slimeballs; plant growth uses stamina.
item.slimic.tunnel_slime.tooltip: Select Tunnel to bore a 3×3 passage in the chosen direction. Needs mining tools, lining blocks, and an empty bucket for fluids.
item.slimic.dragon_slime.tooltip: Equip a sword and select Fight for flying melee and targeted flame breath. Shares Combat Slime target filters and equipment.
item.slimic.meow_slime.tooltip: Repels nearby creepers while Active, even during Wait. Roam and the creeper-repelling aura can be controlled independently.
item.slimic.companion.summon_tooltip: Use on a block or water source to summon this companion. Initially waits.

item.slimic.slime_scanner.detail: Hold in either hand to keep the preview (15s).
jei.slimic.slime_scanner: Place a Slime Tuner in the center and glass blocks directly above, below, left, and right. Right-click an owned or shared companion within normal interaction reach (eight-block maximum) to preview its current or planned work area for fifteen seconds. Hold the scanner in either hand to keep the outline visible. Shift-right-click still recovers the companion.
message.slimic.portal_unavailable: Portal travel failed: check the exit space and travel permissions.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.title: The Interrupted Ledger
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page1: North workshop asked again. I rolled the same empty crate to the gate so they would hear its wheels. Eight stones remain in the lower chest. We must keep one road open.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page2: We kept the lamps lit for XXX. Their last mark points through the green arch. Rain has washed the road away, but none of us has heard the call to put out the light.
jei.slimic.world_building: Gather materials in The Slimic through a slime-block portal activated with a slimeball. Process local stone with a stonecutter, or use the listed crafting and smelting recipes. Building blocks have a separate Creative tab.
item.slimic.royal_guard_slime.tooltip: Defends its assigned post and shields nearby allies while working.
item.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core.t: Use on a Slime Restoration Station with one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory.
message.slimic.ancient_core_invalid: This core has no valid ancient identity.
message.slimic.ancient_core_redeemed: This ancient core has already been restored.
message.slimic.ancient_restoration_mater: Restoration requires one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory.
message.slimic.ancient_restored: Restored %s. Release it to meet your new companion; it will wait at one health.
jei.slimic.royal_guard_slime: Combine a Combat Slime and an Ancient Command Seal without a fixed arrangement. Growth, identity, health, equipment, cargo and ownership are retained. Alternatively, restore an Ancient Guard core at a Slime Restoration Station. Select Fight to defend the current post. With a shield, it takes 35% of a nearby ally’s combat damage, consuming stamina. Target filters and PvP protection apply.
jei.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core: Ruin guard, transport, and command cores use one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball at an intact Slime Restoration Station. Mining, tunnel, and mine-guardian cores instead use one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball in the Overworld. Break mineralized mine corpses or defeat remnants to obtain cores. Restoration gives a new owned companion at one health in Wait, with 12–28 upgrades invested in useful stats. Each core keeps its roll and can be restored once.
jei.slimic.ancient_command_seal: Ruin chests have a 20% chance in workshops or supply depots, 35% in archives, and 50% in royal wards to contain one seal. Defeated ruin guards, transports, and Ancient Command Slimes also drop a seal with their core. Use it at a Slime Restoration Station with a core and slimeball, or specialize a Combat Slime into a Royal Guard.
lore.slimic.supply_ledger.page3: Our watchkeeper scattered beside the dais. I pressed its cold seal to the lump it left, then added a little of our gel. On the unbroken stone, it trembled. Perhaps it still hears us.
lore.slimic.archive.title: Waiting for XXX
lore.slimic.archive.page1: The first road was a trail our bodies left between two storehouses. We widened it together; more slimes followed. XXX called that little circle a kingdom. I pressed those sounds into wet clay.
lore.slimic.archive.page2: XXX went through the green arch and promised to return. I leave a clean page each morning. The carriers bring only old crates. Today the watch answered an empty road again. I have not scraped the promise from the clay.
lore.slimic.royal.title: The Last Watch
lore.slimic.royal.page1: Hold the work yard until XXX returns. That was the last call. Our gold bands are cracked; the little ones still shelter behind us. No one sits on the high stone now. I keep my place by the old flag.
lore.slimic.royal.page2: A young sword-bearer set the old seal into its shield. It caught a flying stone for our carrier; its old scars were still there. If I scatter, leave my seal beside the piece that still trembles.
block.slimic.command_pedestal.tooltip: Hold a damaged ancient core and right-click with one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory. Mining cores instead use one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball here in the Overworld.
message.slimic.restoration_station_help: Hold a Damaged Ancient Slime Core and right-click this station. Keep one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory. The restored companion item replaces the core. Mining cores instead use one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball here in the Overworld.
jei.slimic.command_pedestal: Found intact in occupied ruins, or craft one with a slimeball, gold ingot, two redstone dust, and three Stone Bricks. Hold a Damaged Ancient Slime Core and right-click with one Ancient Command Seal and one slimeball in your inventory. The core becomes a companion summon item at one health, waiting on release. Cracked stations cannot restore cores. Mining cores instead use one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball here in the Overworld.
item.slimic.ancient_mining_slime.tooltip: Restored quarry veteran: prioritizes ores in its current layer and uses half stamina for work and movement.
item.slimic.ancient_tunnel_slime.tooltip: Restored tunnel veteran: uses half stamina for work and movement and mines ancient Slimic masonry 50% faster with an effective tool.
item.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core.m: In the Overworld, use a Slime Restoration Station with one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball.
message.slimic.mine_restoration_overworl: Bring this mining core to a Slime Restoration Station in the Overworld.
message.slimic.mine_restoration_material: Restoration requires one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball in your inventory.
jei.slimic.ancient_mining_slime: Break mineralized remains in a newly generated collapsed quarry or defeat a Forgotten Mining Slime, then restore its core in the Overworld with one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball. Ores in the active layer take priority; work and movement use half stamina. Starts waiting at one health.
jei.slimic.ancient_tunnel_slime: Break mineralized remains in a newly generated collapsed tunnel or defeat a Forgotten Tunnel Slime, then restore its core in the Overworld with one Old Command Fragment and one slimeball. Work and movement use half stamina; effective tools mine ancient Slimic masonry 50% faster. Starts waiting at one health.
jei.slimic.old_command_fragment: Collapsed-mine supply chests contain one fragment per corpse. Defeating a mine remnant with a player or companion also drops one. Mine cores use one fragment and one slimeball at a Slime Restoration Station in the Overworld.
item.slimic.damaged_ancient_slime_core.t: Restores with 12–28 invested upgrades in useful stats; each core keeps its own roll.
jei.slimic.restoration.title: Slime Restoration
screen.slimic.recommended_warning: Above the recommended range; you can still apply.
screen.slimic.invalid_tuning: Enter finite, valid numbers; slots and points need whole numbers.

lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.title: The Gate Still Holds
lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.page1: I counted the shields again. Three lean upon the same broken cart, yet the gate receives orders for nine. Our carriers no longer answer. XXX has not crossed the road since the lamps went dark.
lore.slimic.sanctum.courtyard.page2: We pressed the courtyard seal into the relay. Its memory should outlast our bodies. Beyond the fallen banners, the narrow opening leads to the command gallery. Leave the seal here if your bag grows heavy; the relay remembers.
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.title: Two Final Orders
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.page1: At dawn: hold the inner gate. At dusk: open every passage for XXX. Both bear the same mark. Our commander repeats them without pause. We began to strike one another while carrying out the very same duty.
lore.slimic.sanctum.gallery.page2: The survey needle follows the sleeping room beyond this gallery. Carry it along the central passage. The second relay keeps the gallery seal; together with the courtyard memory, it can wake the deepest command device.
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.title: A Body for Two Memories
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.page1: The old miner offered its core. The younger one folded itself beside it. We took away their picks and emptied every pocket before touching the apparatus. Nothing worn or carried may pass through its rings.
lore.slimic.sanctum.laboratory.page2: Four drops of slime and two old command fragments steady the rings. Neither body returns. Their practiced strength becomes a reserve the new child must learn to shape. The royal core lies beyond the descending passage, beneath the final watch.
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.title: The Order That Remains
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.page1: The last guardian still waits for a voice that does not arrive. I have left both seals in the fortress memory. Once its watch ends, one royal core may leave this place. The empty housing must remain empty.
lore.slimic.sanctum.core.page2: Gold shoulders, redstone veins, the ancient seal, and three bricks will hold the core upright again. XXX once asked whether a command could survive its speaker. I cannot answer. Outside, our brothers are still working.

jei.slimic.sanctum.path: Find map fragments in new The Slimic mines and ruins. Combine three, bind the map in The Slimic, and explore a Fallen Sanctum. Restore both chamber memories to obtain its single shared royal core.
jei.slimic.next_generation_mining_slime: Use a Royal Synthesis Station with your recovered ordinary and Ancient Mining Slimes, four slimeballs, and two Old Command Fragments. Empty equipment and bags first. Verified growth returns unused; the child starts in Wait. It inherits half stamina costs in every policy. Precision Prospecting excavates a 2×2 shaft and supported branches to selected ores behind walls, bypassing liquids and unsafe cavities when possible.
